C1377.title: Ecovacs Smart Home Device Surveillance Incident Sparks Privacy Concerns
C1377.summary: In May 2024, Ecovacs Deebot X2 robot vacuums in several U.S. cities were remotely controlled by unauthorized users. Devices moved unexpectedly, chased a pet, and played abusive speech through their speakers. Interviewed users said that camera and microphone functions could potentially be accessed without authorization. The incident highlights privacy-security risks in remote access controls, account protection, and vulnerability remediation for smart-home devices with audio and video capabilities.
